message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays that Canadians can enjoy in 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, giving you at least one full weekend day plus the holiday itself.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Friday | ✅ | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces and territories. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | ✅ | Celebrated on the last Monday in May. |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Monday | ✅ | First Monday in September. |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | ✅ | Second Monday in October. |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | ✅ | Christmas is a statutory holiday nationwide. |

> **Pro‑provincial notes**  
> • **Family Day** (the third Monday in February) is a statutory holiday in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, and Manitoba. It creates a long weekend in those provinces on **February 20, 2023**.  
> • **St. Patrick’s Day** (March 17) is a statutory holiday in Newfoundland & Labrador, and it gives a long weekend there on **March 17, 2023**.  
> • **Remembrance Day** (November 11) is a statutory holiday in all provinces, but it falls on a Saturday in 2023, so it does **not** create a long weekend (it is observed on Friday, November 10).  
> • **Canada Day** (July 1) falls on a Saturday in 2023, so it is observed on Monday, July 3, and does **not** give a long weekend.  

### Quick‑look calendar view

```
2023 Long‑Weekend Holidays (Canada)

  Apr 7 – Good Friday (Fri)
  May 22 – Victoria Day (Mon)
  Sep 4 – Labour Day (Mon)
  Oct 9 – Thanksgiving (Mon)
  Dec 25 – Christmas Day (Mon)

  (Provincial long weekends: Family Day Feb 20, St. Patrick’s Day Mar 17)
```

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific details or a full list of all statutory holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends), let me know!
